speaker: Doctor
text:
I see you have a history of gait and limb ataxia; to narrow this down, have you ever noticed issues with swallowing, speaking, or vision changes like double vision or nystagmus? 

Also, do you have a family history of similar neurological symptoms, or have you experienced any unexplained weight loss or fatigue recently?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That sounds like significant ataxia; have you noticed any changes in your vision, such as double vision or a "tunnel vision" effect, or any difficulty swallowing recently? Also, is there anyone in your family with similar neurological problems or a history of unexplained weight loss?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year. To keep my notes clear, please give only one final answer and keep it to a single direct conclusion.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive multifocal leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy.
